description: This file defines the 'TypeManifestProviderAttribute' class, a custom attribute used to specify a metadata provider type for an assembly in Orleans serialization configuration. It includes validation logic to ensure the provider type implements a specific interface.

classes.name: TypeManifestProviderAttribute
classes.description: A sealed attribute class used to annotate assemblies with a type that provides metadata for serialization purposes.

methods.name: TypeManifestProviderAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the attribute with a provider type, validating that it is non-null and implements ITypeManifestProvider.
